ENGLISH: Nastulus, please, when even was the last time \n something like this was accepted by the university?
Some… 30 years ago. \n If my memory doesn’t betray me, that is.
This is too much responsibility, \n I’ve barely finished my studies with you!
Mariam, listen to me, I’ve seen many, \n many students of the stars in my time…
They are not here in your place today, \n think about why that is.
Master, I want to continue your work and…
I want to teach in your name, I do, \n but I’m not ready… I don’t think I can be like you.
Then teach the things I taught you. \n And teach them the way I taught you…
Think of the founding story, you are like al-Fihriya \n before she decided to build the university.
You are about to do something great… \n You just don’t know it yet.
Will it still be proper for me to come to you? \n When I need your advice?
You will always be my most welcome student Mariam. \n Even though no man-
-ever steps in the same river twice.
